The proof starts with a n+1 -qubit product state whose QFT_q ( 2^n leq q < 2^(n+1) ) has constant amplitude on two adjacent frequencies with complementary binary representations.
For instance, the frequencies 2^(n)-1 and 2^(n) have binary representations 01dots 1 and 10dots 0 respectively.
